readerCopy.body: Waiting for someone to guess what is needed can turn disappointment into evidence that they do not care. When the Moon squares Chiron, care and sensitivity create friction, allowing a genuine need to collide with an old belief that asking for it is embarrassing, excessive, or unsafe. Silence becomes a test the other person does not know they are taking. The relationship becomes easier to evaluate once the request exists in the same reality as the response.
